description: Look up a published Australian suburb by name or postcode and get its SuburbScanner id and page. Use the id with get_suburb_local_context and search_major_projects. Returns up to 10 matches.

query.description: A suburb name or a 4-digit postcode, for example "Wollongong" or "2500".

state.description: Optional: limit to one state or territory.

name: find_suburb
title: Find an Australian suburb
